blockbench.method: Bedrock cuboid import/export mirrors X and negates X/Y rotation; explicit per-face uv_size and bone pivots. Used same coordinate convention in editable source and software pose checks.

geckolib.method: GeoModel resource selection, cached bone lookup and animation processing; project kept Forge1.20.1/GeckoLib4.8.4. Existing client renderers remain authoritative; only rebel_general gets an additional art binding.

plugins.method: GeckoLib format supports bone_rig, optional box UV and Bedrock animation codec. Export editable .bbmodel with embedded PNG; no new plugins installed.

ignis.observed: Official screenshot viewed: body is subordinate to large shield and long heavy weapon; prominent layered shoulders and separated lower torso. Source inspected upperbody/lowerbody, arm joints and weapon roots. Borrowed mass hierarchy, never copied shield/sword design or assets.

revenant.observed: Official screenshot viewed: dark central torso bounded by broad segmented lateral shields, restricted light accents. Borrowed large lateral masses and dark/recessed versus bright/armoured grouping only.

lich.observed: Actual create/setupAnim code inspected: tilted separate collar, long cloak, very thin arms, upper-body contrast and casting pose. This is source-based structural study; wiki image unavailable due certificate error.

knight.observed: Actual model source inspected: armour shell and helmet trophy hierarchy, coarse two-segment horns. Borrowed helmet/shoulder readability, not horn design.

snow_queen.observed: Actual create/crown source inspected: long robe body with thin extremities and angular crown extensions. Borrowed upper-crown/lower-robe silhouette contrast; not costume or palette.
